name: Mukesh Arambakam
description: Mukesh Arambakam is a Staff AI/ML Engineer at Genesys in Dublin, building next-generation AI agents and LLM-powered applications across GenAI, RAG, and scalable ML infrastructure.
tagline: I'm a Staff AI/ML Engineer at Genesys, architecting next-generation AI agents and LLM-powered applications. With 7+ years in software and 5+ years focused on NLP, machine translation, and generative AI - backed by a Master's in Data Science.
bio: I design and deliver end-to-end machine learning systems - from data preprocessing and model training through evaluation, optimization, and production deployment. My recent work centers on generative AI: fine-tuning LLMs with PEFT methods, building agentic AI systems, and shipping scalable, production-ready applications.

Earlier in my career I spent five years deep in natural language processing and neural machine translation, building evaluation frameworks and language tooling that operated across 190+ languages. That mix of research depth and engineering pragmatism is what I bring to hard AI problems today.
beyondWork: Outside of engineering you'll find me reading, playing basketball, and keeping up with the relentless pace of AI research.

focus.title: LLMs & GenAI
focus.body: Fine-tuning, prompting, and productionizing large language models for real workloads.

focus.title: AI Agents & RAG
focus.body: Orchestrating multi-step agentic systems and retrieval pipelines with LangGraph and MCP.

focus.title: ML Infrastructure
focus.body: Scalable, efficient serving - quantization, ONNX, and clean FastAPI system design.
